test_operator_overloading: test the pybind11 Vector2 and Vector arithmetic operators including add, subtract, multiply, divide, and in-place variants
test_operators_notimplemented: test that C1 and C2 cross-type operators return NotImplemented for correct fallback behavior
test_nested: test nested class operator overloading on NestA, NestB, and NestC with in-place arithmetic
test_overriding_eq_reset_hash: test that overriding eq resets hash to unhashable and verify Hashable classes support hashing
test_return_set_of_unhashable: test that returning a set of unhashable objects raises a TypeError with the correct cause
